offending_extra_words: revocable only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 4
reasons: Preferred level incomplete: the grant is still neither perpetual/irrevocable for paid-up use nor limited to termination for uncured material breach; tying revocation to any Section 4 termination event is materially weaker than the locked target.

Successor transferability is not achieved at either level: 'non-transferable, non-assignable (except as permitted under this Agreement)' is a dangling cross-reference that grants no express M&A/successor transfer right, so the fallback also fails.

Minimality fails: the operation rewrites the whole grant sentence (34 to 61 words, ratio 1.79) where a short insertion for affiliates/contractors plus a tight revocation qualifier would suffice, and it adds a broad new exception '(except as permitted under this Agreement)'.

Intent risk: 'Affiliates' is capitalised but not shown as a defined term in the Agreement, introducing an undefined term; the vague assignment carve-out could conflict with the separate assignment provision.

Recommended tighter edit: strike 'revocable' and insert 'irrevocable except for Customer's uncured material breach', and add 'provided that Customer may assign this licence to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets'.
